use default

zigzag(n: int) -> LIST[LIST[int]] is
    let cells = LIST()

    for _ in 0..n do
        cells.add(stream(0, v => v || v + 1)
            |> take(n)
            |> map(_ => 0)
            |> collect_list())
    od

    let row mut = 0
    let column mut = 0

    for value in 0..(n * n) do
        cells[row][column] = value

        if (row + column) % 2 == 0 then
            if column == n - 1 then
                row = row + 1
            elif row == 0 then
                column = column + 1
            else
                row = row - 1
                column = column + 1
            fi
        else
            if row == n - 1 then
                column = column + 1
            elif column == 0 then
                row = row + 1
            else
                row = row + 1
                column = column - 1
            fi
        fi
    od

    cells
si
